title: 'Good day to drown a few sorrows,' says King as he pours pint
originalTitle: 'Good day to drown a few sorrows,' says King as he pours pint
content:
King Charles III has hinted at England's World Cup semi-final loss to Argentina as he poured a pint in a pub.

"Maybe it's a good day to drown a few sorrows," he said to laughter, while Queen Camilla smiled as she stood next to him at the Hall & Woodhouse Badger Brewery in Blandford, near Poole in Dorset.
